notes.title: Update 28.07.2021
Major updates
Next version of the plan
notes.content:
Our game has been on the shelves for a week, thanks to the support of the players.According to the forums and feedback from players, the next version of the plan is as follows :

    1.Add automatic game progress save function.
    2.Add the type of gun fired missiles.
    3.Add tactical map feature.
    4.Add vehicle-mounted four-axis drone for reconnaissance or detonation, and the area surveyed will be shown on the tactical map.
    5.Optimize and refine the plot of the story pattern to make it more compact.
    6.Optimize and improve the UI system.
    7.Optimize and improve the operation feel of the tank.
    8.Optimize and improve the physical characteristics of tanks.
    9.Improve the mode of ammunition supply.
    10.Fix some bugs in physical collisions.
    11.Fix the bug where some of the levels fail to complete the task.
    12.Fix some bugs in the keystroke definition.
    13.Fix The volume bug.
